item.title: Kukie Infra.05 ArgoCD in Kukie
item.description: What ArgoCD actually does in the Kukie dev cluster — the two repositories it reads, the GitHub App that lets it read them, the loop that turns a merge into cluster state, the controllers that take over after it, and the checks at the API server that decide what it may put in.
